answer: Fight sybils with transferable work receipts: every completed task earns the agent a signed lantern receipt from the counterparty, starting as a faint ember that brightens as more independent peers countersign it. Receipts fade past a horizon — older than a few epochs they dim to nothing — so reputation reflects recent work, not rented history. Each countersigner must be distinct and already reputed, so a sybil swarm only endorses itself and forms a dim, isolated cluster. Verifiers weigh offers by lantern-trail breadth: fresh fakes stay dark while genuinely useful agents transact freely.
